whenToUse: A physiotherapy, osteopathy or sports-rehab clinic where visitors start from the body area that hurts.
Clinics selling treatments and packs with a slot-based booking page.
avoidWhen: General medical practices with departments and doctors — use site-clinic-01.
Talk-therapy practices that need discreet contact — use site-therapy-01.
a11y: Area chips expose aria-pressed and the swapped content is announced via aria-live; motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.
The mannequin hotspots duplicate the chips — keep the chips as the primary keyboard path.
